from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout
        lecture_lines = [
            "Meet Willa and her rotating laser beam line.",
            "She starts at an initial point on the plane.",
            "The beam rotates clockwise around this pivot point.",
            "When hitting another point, the pivot immediately switches.",
            "This creates the \"Windmill\" motion through the points."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Introduction to 'Willa the Windmill'", lecture_lines)

        # Positions for points
        pos_p = self.grid['C3']
        pos_q = self.grid['D5']
        other_positions = [self.grid['A2'], self.grid['B5'], self.grid['E2']]

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Fade in 5 white points (#FFFFFF) at random positions.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        point_p = Dot(pos_p, color=WHITE)
        point_q = Dot(pos_q, color=WHITE)
        points_others = VGroup(*[Dot(pos, color=WHITE) for pos in other_positions])
        all_points = VGroup(point_p, point_q, *points_others)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(all_points))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Label one 'P'. Draw a yellow line through 'P'.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        label_p = Text("P", font_size=20, color=WHITE).next_to(point_p, UP, buff=0.1)
        # Using a line that is long enough to span the grid area
        line_angle = ValueTracker(PI / 3) # Starting angle
        pivot = ValueTracker(pos_p)
        
        # Laser beam line
        laser_line = Line(
            start=pos_p + 4 * np.array([np.cos(PI/3), np.sin(PI/3), 0]),
            end=pos_p - 4 * np.array([np.cos(PI/3), np.sin(PI/3), 0]),
            color=YELLOW
        )
        
        def line_updater(obj):
            angle = line_angle.get_value()
            p = pivot.get_vector()
            direction = np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0])
            obj.set_points_as_corners([p - 4 * direction, p + 4 * direction])

        laser_line.add_updater(line_updater)
        
        self.play(Create(laser_line), FadeIn(label_p))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Rotate the yellow line clockwise around 'P'.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Calculate target angle to hit Q
        vec_pq = pos_q - pos_p
        target_angle = np.arctan2(vec_pq[1], vec_pq[0])
        # To ensure clockwise rotation from PI/3 (60 deg) to target_angle
        # target_angle will be around -14 deg for D5 from C3
        
        self.play(line_angle.animate.set_value(target_angle), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # As the line hits point 'Q', label it 'Q' and flash it yellow (#FFFF00).
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        label_q = Text("Q", font_size=20, color=WHITE).next_to(point_q, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(
            point_q.animate.scale(1.5).set_color(YELLOW),
            FadeIn(label_q)
        )
        self.play(point_q.animate.scale(1/1.5))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Change 'P' to white and set the green color (#2ECC71) to 'Q' as the new pivot.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Setup for rotation around Q
        self.play(
            point_p.animate.set_color(WHITE),
            point_q.animate.set_color("#2ECC71")
        )
        
        # Update pivot to Q and continue clockwise rotation slightly
        pivot.set_value(pos_q)
        self.play(line_angle.animate.set_value(target_angle - PI/4), run_time=1.5, rate_func=linear)
        
        self.wait(2)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE)
